game_title: Point Black Lighthouse - Alone Against the Dark
global_style: dark retro pixel art Lovecraftian horror
camera_rules: first-person perspective, wide room view, player looking forward at scene, no HUD elements
palette_rules: desaturated stone grays, sickly moss greens, unnatural cyan/purple glows, deep blacks, minimal bright colors
lighting_philosophy: sources are unnatural or constrained; no bright daylight unless outdoor beach scene
forbidden: modern objects (cars, phones, electricity beyond oil lamps)

contamination_visual_rules.0_25: Subtle wrongness. Faint cracks, slight color shifts, barely perceptible.
contamination_visual_rules.25_50: Visible corruption. Symbols appear, colors warp slightly, geometry feels off.
contamination_visual_rules.50_75: Heavy corruption. Unnatural angles, bioluminescent growths, reality bends.
contamination_visual_rules.75_100: Overwhelming. Reality breaks down, impossible geometry, non-euclidean space.

danger_visual_rules.1: Safe, calm, mundane. Some decay but stable.
danger_visual_rules.2: Unsettling. Subtle wrong details, increasing decay.
danger_visual_rules.3: Threatening. Obvious supernatural signs, danger implied.
danger_visual_rules.4: Imminent danger. Hostile presence visible, reality failing.
danger_visual_rules.5: Lethal. Immediate threat, entity present, survival uncertain.

prompt_template_base: Retro pixel-art horror game background, Lovecraftian 1920s New England, [location_description], first-person perspective, wide composition, 4:3 aspect ratio, cohesive dark palette, oppressive atmosphere, game asset quality, no characters no UI no text, readable and playable.
